name: Hartebeesthoek94 / Lo27 forward and inverse (EPSG::2052 — Lo27, documented as EPSG::2053 in country-config)

source.document: EPSG::2052 — Hartebeesthoek94 / Lo27 (country-config reports as EPSG:2053 for Lo27)
source.page: EPSG registry + EPSG Geomatics Guidance Note 7-2 §1.3.5 (Transverse Mercator)
source.notes: Transverse Mercator (south-orientated EPSG:9808 variant is westing/southing; fixture stores standard east/north for sidecar compatibility, where westing = −easting and southing = −northing). For the south-orientated EPSG definition, expected as (Westing= −120450.30, Southing=2844145.91). Projection: central meridian 27°E, latitude of origin 0°, false easting 0 m, false northing 0 m, scale factor 1.0, WGS84 ellipsoid (Hartebeesthoek94 = WGS84 realization). Input geographic is Hartebeesthoek94/WGS84. Frozen from sidecar Snyder series (USGS PP-1395 §8) validated against pyproj custom tmerc lon_0=27 (E=120450.2957, N=−2844145.9124, diff 0.00001 m). Pyproj EPSG:2053 with wsu axis gives 80298.148/2843841.976 for Lo29 (lon_0=29) — not used; this fixture is Lo27 lon_0=27.

projection.method: Transverse Mercator (EPSG::9807; south-orientated variant EPSG::9808 is westing/southing)

cases.name: Pretoria (−25.7°, 28.2° → Lo27)
cases.notes: Pretoria, Gauteng. Cross-checked with pyproj custom +proj=tmerc +lon_0=27 +axis=enu (E=120450.2957, N=−2844145.9124). South-orientated (wsu) equivalent is Westing=120450.30? Actually wsu gives Westing=−120450.30, Southing=2844145.91. Sidecar stores east/north; conversion is sign flip. Task mapping uses EPSG:2053 for Lo27; real EPSG:2053 is Lo29 (lon_0=29) — fixture documents the mismatch.

roundtrip_test.description: Forward then inverse must reproduce the input geographic coordinates to within 1e-7 deg (~1 cm).
